items.title: Where build's fixed cost crosses buy's growing fee
items.description: Build's cost (engineers, compliance) barely moves with volume. Buy's cost is a percentage of volume, so it scales with growth. Drag the volume slider to find the point where the two lines cross — at the default $12M/3 years, this reproduces the unit's own numbers.
items.compute: const buildTCO = 700000 + 450000 * params.years; const buyTCO = 0.033 * params.volume * params.years; return { buildTCO, buyTCO };
